title: Pure Predaplant
summary: Predaplant cards and the Starving Venom Dragons, plus Polymerization, Super Polymerization and generic staples. The page's combo lines add Branded, Rose Dragon and Clear Wing cards, so they use cards this list leaves out. Starving Venom Wing Dragon needs a Clear Wing monster, so it stays out, and Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heavenly Dragons isn't out in the TCG until 12 November 2026. Daredevil, the newest card, Tributes a monster with a Predator Counter from either field to summon itself and destroys Spells/Traps. The 2026 Tuner Longinephila searches any Predap card and Lilizard adds Polymerization.

exclude.Starving Venom Wing Dragon: Needs a Clear Wing monster as material.
exclude.Starving Venom Fusion Dragon, Four Heave: TCG release 2026-11-12; add it after that date.
